content: Floating point is deterministic per IEEE-754 but not reproducible across machines/compilers/instruction sets/parallel-reduction order. Hashing raw floats amplifies this since hash functions do not map near-equal values to equal hashes. Practical mitigations: fixed-point conversion, canonical decimal round-trip serialization, or explicit rounding/quantization to a coarser fixed precision before hashing so equivalent-up-to-noise values collapse to the same hash.
